card.name: Inside long medical word stems
card.fires_on: Partway through long medical words, most often the 'itin' ending of ferritin in iron-level monitoring text. It also fires on pieces of words like cyclooxygenase, adrenergic, analgesia and xanthine oxidase.

modes.description: The 'itin' ending of ferritin when serum ferritin is being measured or used as a treatment target.
